landing.faq_q1_title: Who can access the Nexus portal?
landing.faq_q1_desc: The portal is strictly intended for active enrolled students, employees, teachers, and administrative staff. Access is provided solely via direct invitation from coordination.

landing.faq_q4_title: How do administrative staff and teachers manage their duties?
landing.faq_q4_desc: Teachers and administration have dedicated modules for entering grades, tracking tasks, managing projects, overseeing lunch rosters, and system reports.

gantt.description: What lasts how long and what overlaps with what. The calendar answers “what happens on Tuesday?”; this answers “what runs at the same time?”.

programs.participants: {count, plural, =0 {No participants} one {# participant} other {# participants}}
programs.materials: {count, plural, =0 {No material} one {# material} other {# materials}}
programs.deleteWarning: The program is deleted. It cannot be restored from the site.
programs.inUseHint: {count, plural, one {There is # material attached to this program, and deleting it would take it down too.} other {There are # materials attached to this program, and deleting it would take them down too.}} Delete them first, or mark the program “Inactive” to retire it while keeping what it has.
programs.emptyHint: Create the first one and it will show up here with its facilitator and dates.
programs.noMatchesHint: Try another type, another state, or clear the filters.

materials.title: Academy materials
materials.description: Each program's repository: guides, presentations, videos and links, grouped by the academy they belong to.
materials.privacyHint: Files live in the private store, the same one as submissions and student records. There is no public link: every download signs its own, and it expires in ten minutes.
materials.formSubtitle: Upload a file, add a link, or both. It has to carry something.
materials.deleteWarning: The material is removed from the repository.
materials.deleteWarningFile: The material and its file in the store are both deleted. This cannot be undone.
materials.emptyHint: Upload the first guide or paste a link, and it will be filed under its program.
materials.noMatchesHint: Try another program, another type, or clear the filters.
materials.noProgramsHint: Every material belongs to an academy. Create a program and upload it again.

form.datesInvalid: Check the dates: the end cannot come before the start.
form.participantsInvalid: Participants must be a whole number of 0 or more.
form.contentRequired: A material has to carry a file or a link.
form.linkInvalid: The link must start with “https://” or be a site path starting with “/”.
form.fileInvalid: That file type is not accepted. Use a PDF, image, presentation or document.
form.fileTooBig: The file is over 20 MB. Host it elsewhere and put the link here.
form.error: Could not complete. Please try again.

sitemap.title: Sitemap
sitemap.description: Every module in the system, role by role, with its route and its permission. What your account can open is marked.
sitemap.sourceHint: This screen carries no hand-written list: it walks the same menu that draws the sidebar, for all seven roles. A new module shows up here on its own.

shared.title: Shared modules
shared.hint: The ones that appear in more than one role's menu. Counted, not listed by hand.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: The Foundation's reports, with every figure computed over the whole database and not over a sample. You only see the tabs your role allows.
reports.forbidden: You do not have access to reports
reports.forbiddenHint: Reading operations, the academic catalogue or the finances is required. Ask coordination for it.

ops.byStateHint: Every registered project, grouped by its state.
ops.tasksHint: Includes the ones that hang off no project: they are the team's work just the same.
ops.progressHint: Completed tasks over live tasks. Cancelled ones do not count, so cancelling one never lowers the progress.
ops.withoutTasks: {count, plural, one {# project has no tasks yet, so it is not shown: its progress is not 0%, it is not known yet.} other {# projects have no tasks yet, so they are not shown: their progress is not 0%, it is not known yet.}}

academic.distributionHint: The four bands of the grading scale, counted over every grade in the term.
academic.byTypeHint: Where the grade is won and lost: exam, homework, project, participation or final.
academic.byCourseHint: The twelve courses with the best average. A course with no grades does not appear: its average is not zero, it does not exist.

finance.allTimeHint: All four figures cover everything recorded, with no date filter. For a specific month, the filter lives in Accounting.
finance.flowHint: The last six months. Months with no activity are drawn anyway, so that months which are not consecutive do not look like they are.
finance.categoryHint: Only categories that have something. Blue is what comes in, black what goes out.

aiChat.title: Internal AI chat
aiChat.description: Questions about how the Foundation is doing, with the system's figures at hand. It also helps draft and summarise.
aiChat.privacy: The assistant receives aggregate figures for the Foundation —students, courses, grades, projects, tasks, sponsors and events— trimmed by your permissions: if you cannot see the finances in the menu, neither can it. It never receives people's names, student records, or anything from psychology, not even a count of appointments. Conversations are stored in the system.
aiChat.emptyHint: It knows what the dashboards show: figures, project progress, grades and upcoming events. Start with one of the suggestions.

prompt.summary: Summarise the Foundation's situation in five lines

aiChat.errorTooLong: The question is too long. Shorten it and try again.
aiChat.errorLimit: You have hit the hourly question limit. It is a spending cap: try again in a while.
aiChat.errorNoKey: The assistant is not configured: a valid API key is missing. Let the technical team know.
aiChat.errorRefused: The assistant declined to answer that. Try asking it another way.
aiChat.error: Could not answer. Please try again.
aiChat.forbidden: You do not have access to the assistant
aiChat.forbiddenHint: The “ia.usar” permission is required. Ask coordination for it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unread: {count, plural, one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}
notifications.emptyHint: Tasks assigned to you and requests that reach you show up here.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: What has been done in the system, who did it and when. Written by requests, home announcements, student records, the academic catalog, accounting and academies.
audit.clinicalNotice: Rows from the former psychology module, from before it closed in October 2026, show their action, author and time, but not their content or the record they refer to.
audit.emptyHint: As soon as someone creates, edits or deletes something that leaves a trail, it will show up here.
audit.noMatchesHint: Try other dates, another entity, or clear the filters.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The platform's settings, the accounts that exist, and what each role can do.

staff.title: Staff
staff.desc: Create accounts, change roles, activate and deactivate, and reset access.

accounts.title: System accounts
accounts.hint: Work accounts, students excluded. This screen only lists them: managing them is another screen.
accounts.name: Name

settings.rolesHint: It comes from the same function that decides access, so it cannot contradict the system. Its source is the “rol” and “rol_permiso” tables: if a permission is missing or extra here, the database is what to change.
settings.parametersNotice: Institutional parameters cannot be edited here yet, and that is not an oversight: no table exists to store them, so a form on this screen would write into thin air. What are parameters today live where they are used —the lunch cut-off time comes from the same SQL as the kitchen list, and academic terms are managed in their own module—. Centralising them is a migration, for when it is needed.

requests.studentDescription: Ask administration for a certificate, a letter, leave or an appointment. Every step shows up here, with who handles it and what they answer.
requests.staffDescription: Student paperwork and internal approvals —enrollments, scholarships and expenses—. Every request goes through named, dated steps, and nobody approves their own.
requests.pendingEmpty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.

typeHint.constancia: Of studies or scholarship. Say which institution it is for.
typeHint.cita_administracion: The time is a preference; administration confirms it.
typeHint.permiso: To miss a class, a workshop or service.
typeHint.otro: Anything that doesn't fit the others.
typeHint.alta_expediente: Move a candidate from the pipeline to active student. Approved by administration.
typeHint.beca: Assign or change a scholarship. Approved by administration and then by the director.
typeHint.gasto: Approved by accounting, and by the director if large.

form.amountHint: From {umbral} USD it also needs director approval.
form.detailPlaceholder: What the reviewer needs to know.
form.success: Request sent. You'll see every step in the list.

error.invalido: Check the fields: something required is missing or a value is invalid.
error.fecha_invalida: The date is missing or already past.
error.duplicada: You already have a request of this kind in progress.
